cases.name: Renita R. Hawthorne
cases.about: Her Go Fund Me said: "Renita was an amazing mother, sister, aunt, cousin, and friend who loved her family. She was the friendliest person who always kept a smile on her face even when she was down."
cases.narrative:
He committed a planned arson attack over a drug debt owed by Hawthorne's son. Firefighters were able to rescue three people, including two children, by breaking through a bedroom window. However, Hawthorne was trapped inside and was later found unconscious inside the home. She was taken to the University of Texas Medical Branch at Galveston Trauma Center, where she later died from carbon monoxide poisoning and thermal injuries. Galveston County District Attorney Felony Division Chief Adam Poole for the prosecution. He argued that Thompson intentionally set a fire at every exit of the home to ensure no one could escape.

"He likened Thompson’s actions to building a tomb and then setting it on fire," the DA’s office said.

cases.name: Anita "Annie" Leal
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She was known to her grandchildren as Mimi and Mimi Annie.



Annie was a graduate of Dominican High School and went on to work as a nurse’s aide at St. Mary’s Hospital until her children were born. She then became a stay-at-home mom and was actively involved in her children's school activities at St. Patrick Catholic School and O'Connell. She would keep her children busy with many extra-curricular activities. Once her children were grown, she then worked in the Social Work Department at St. Mary’s. Annie was a devoted member of St. Patrick Catholic Church and served as a chairperson of the sweets booth at the Annual Church Bazaar. Annie and her husband sponsored and played in the Galveston YMCA Volleyball League (Galveston Paint Co). She loved working in her yard, cooking, decorating, having her kids’ friends and family over for pool days, and hosting Thanksgiving and Christmas for her family. Annie participated in a line dance group and loved to show off her dance moves at home and at Salsa’s on Mariachi night. Annie and Ernest would frequent their favorite places to eat, with fellow church members on Sundays, including their favorites America’s Kitchen and El Nopalito. She always had her hair done and was always accessorized. She was passionate, energetic, strong, sharp, and always super mom/Mimi."
cases.narrative: He allegedly shot her in the head.
